Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q2 2023 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of COST.
Our cloud segment grew 13% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
Revenue guidance of $23.8 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q2 2023.
Our gross margin expanded by 49 basis points to 21.5%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 49 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
Thank you for the question. We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $2.43 per share.
Second question - Analyst:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
